list: Official trophy list as published by PlayStation (Exophase / PSNProfiles, 18 Nov 2026)

trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: Earn the other 54 trophies and the platinum pops automatically when the last one lands. No online trophies and no DLC are needed for it.

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: Story trophy. Finish the first main mission, Gone Fishing, in Chapter 1. It pops as you play and cannot be missed.

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Story trophy. Finish Chapter 1; it pops as the next chapter begins and cannot be missed.

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Story trophy. Finish Chapter 2; it pops as Chapter 3 begins and cannot be missed.

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Story trophy. Finish Chapter 3; it pops as Chapter 4 begins and cannot be missed.

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Story trophy. Finish Chapter 4 by completing its final main mission, Starting From Zero.

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: Story trophy. Finish the final mission of the game (Chapter 5). Keep a manual save from just before it, because there is no mission replay.

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: Story trophy. Complete the Chapter 2 main mission Breakfast Run; it pops during the mission.

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: Story trophy. Complete the Chapter 3 main mission The Cartel Heist.

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Story trophy. Complete the Chapter 4 main mission Child's Play.

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: Story trophy. Complete the Chapter 4 main mission Headliners.

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: Story trophy. Complete the Chapter 4 main mission VCIA Takedown.

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Story trophy. Complete the final main mission, Operation Savage Glory, in Chapter 5.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: Attain 100% completion. The checklist opens after the story under Progress > Stats > 100% Completion, and progress made during the story already counts. It is lenient, closer to 60% true completion: scan 200 of 277 vehicles, study 100 of 255 animals, finish any 70 of 80 challenges and any 100 optional missions.

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Complete any 250 of the 397 stunts: 130 stunt jumps, 202 under-the-bridge flights, 40 knife flights and 25 base jumps. Mix categories; under-the-bridge flights are the quickest. The 100% checklist needs 300, so keep going past 250.

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try each of the 9 activity types once: fishing, hunting, golf, shooting ranges, pool, basketball, playing a video game, winning a car race / race challenge / drone race, and performing a stunt. Track them under Progress > Activities.

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all 42 shooting range challenges across the 12 ranges. The gold medals are not too hard; work through one range at a time.

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at every one of the 14 locations (42 drone races in total). You only need one win per location, not every race.

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win 20 different races. There are 40 unique race locations, so any 20 wins count; skip the ones you find hardest.

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: After the Chapter 1 mission Feng Shui (meet Cal), Cal texts you a fishing spot marked with a purple map icon. Follow his fishing questline and beat him in a fishing challenge.

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Complete any one of the 4 arcade games: Tenebrae Lux, Street Trash III, Time Jackers Rewind, Bang For Your Buck. The first three are playable on the TV at home from Chapter 1; the fourth is at arcade machines around the world. Finish all levels once; challenges are not required.

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Finish Andy's 5-quest line (Lucia only). It starts with a call from Andy in Chapter 3, then her address in Belville: Climbing the Cellerichain (parts 1-3), Pay the Cellerica Fee, Peach!, Read the Label, Puff Puff Pass. Still available after the story.

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Finish Kenton's treasure-diving line. After the Chapter 1 mission Island Dreams he calls and is marked by the green KR icon in Key Lento. Clear his 7 shipwrecks, digging up treasures with the metal detector. He is briefly unavailable after Chapter 1 but returns in Chapters 2-3.

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Finish Billy's 5-quest line at Thrillbilly Mudclub in Kelly County, marked after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break: Thrillbillies, Twist Wrist Smash Grab, Mall Rats, The Impaler, Hometown Heroes. Still available after the story.

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 stranger mission strands. Only some questlines count: Kirk (Skunk Ape), Kyle (McKittrick Farm), Yago (street racing) and Pilot Pete are confirmed to count; Andy, Billy, Tyrone and Moses do not count. All remain available after the story.

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Finish Randy's Wish List. After the Chapter 3 mission Clonin' Keys, Makin' GS (steal the Zorrusso) he wants 16 sports cars delivered. Scan cars with WAiNK to check the list, then drive them to his garage (green RK icon, west Vice City). Deliver in good condition for more money.

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Finish Tyrone's line (Jason only). After the Chapter 3 mission Here, Kitty Kitty, destroy the synthetic labs (purple markers, quest Take Out Kitty Litter), then do his second quest Spin On This to shut the labs down. Still available after the story.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at all 18 spots across 10 locations; each spot counts twice if both Jason and Lucia meditate there. THE ONE MISSABLE TROPHY: do the Chapter 1 balcony meditation at Jason's house. After the mission Down to Earth, talk to Lucia in the kitchen in the morning, follow her to the balcony and accept. It vanishes after Chapter 1, and it is not yet confirmed whether it is required, so do it and keep a Chapter 1 save.

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Finish Bret Vogel's hunting line (Jason only). After the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break he texts you; meet him in Lummox County for Veteran Hunted. He then marks hunting spots; hunt the animals he requests and bring them back. He gives you the Killtelligence SM-69 rifle in the first quest. Which exact animal pops the trophy is still being confirmed.

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Complete 3 collectible card sets. There are 18 card set locations in total, so you only need any 3 full sets.

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: Scan 100 WAiNK locations with the phone app (hold Up, then R1): 31 landmarks, 35 curiosities, 23 sculptures and No Flusher tags. More than 100 exist, so scan whatever you pass.

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Complete any 50 of the 80 challenges. The 100% checklist needs 70, so this pops on the way; pick the easiest ones and track them under Progress > Challenges.

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: With your partner, lose a 4-star wanted level and escape the heat. Available after Coffee Break (Chapter 2), when you can call your partner. Easiest escape: a fast sports bike through the train tunnel north of Ambrosia, where cops struggle to follow and the helicopter cannot see you. It also pops naturally while robbing the 8 bank vaults.

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: With your partner, rob 3 shops back-to-back without losing your wanted level; keep the flashing wanted level alive the whole chain. A good spot is the 3 jewelry stores in north Vice City (after Chapter 3, Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs). The pop is delayed about 30 seconds after leaving the third shop; hit a fourth if it does not pop.

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles by scanning them with the WAiNK app (hold Up, then R1). Stand on a busy road and scan passing traffic; you do not need to drive them. The 100% checklist needs 200 of 277 base models, so this pops on the way.

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus (L3+R3 while aiming). Buff focus first with food, drink or Adrenaline, wear body armor, and use a full-auto rifle like the Duke 556 on a group of gang enemies. It does not seem to work on soldiers, police or civilians. Focus level rises by playing shooting ranges, golf, pool, fishing and landing headshots.

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Steal a large passenger plane docked at a boarding bridge at VCIA; the ones at departure terminals E3/E4 work, while planes parked on the airfield do not. Go upstairs to the cockpit, reverse to the runway, take off and fly about 1 km from the airport before it pops.

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: Steal a military tank at Mile Zero Air Station, the island at the south-west edge of the map. Tanks stand in the south of the base; drive through the gate or use the stunt jump by the south-east entrance, get in and shoot until it pops.

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected. First finish Chapter 3, Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs, to get the Snap Gun; use it on a locked back door (kicking sets off the alarm), find the safe code note inside and loot the safe. Richardson Jewelry & Diamonds in Vice City is a good target.

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Rob any 5 of the 8 large bank vaults and escape. Unlocks via the Chapter 4 optional mission That's Where The Money Is: tail a security van to a bank, slip in while the vault is open, and bring your partner, because you cannot carry all the cash alone. After that, buy van tips from Yasmani for $10,000 each. Robbing a vault gives a 4-star wanted level instantly.

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an armored truck and escape. It pops automatically in the Chapter 4 mission that unlocks bank vaults: tail the truck to the bank and rob the vault. Earlier method: block a truck near a bank, sticky-bomb its back door, then escape the red heat radius.

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Explore all of Leonida by fully unfogging the map. Fastest by plane: fly over every fogged area until the whole map is visible. PSNProfiles lists a 0/52 progress counter for this trophy.

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob one illegal operation belonging to each of the 9 gangs (39 operations in total; the 100% checklist needs all 39). They show as yellow icons when you get near them; track per-gang counts under Progress > Gangs.

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Not yet confirmed. PowerPyx lists this trophy as currently unknown; the official description is the only hint so far: enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach. It likely pops while playing normally, but no confirmed method has been published yet.

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Not yet confirmed. PowerPyx lists this trophy as currently unknown. The description hints at smashing out of a vehicle showroom in classic style; no confirmed method has been published yet, so do not chase it until a guide pins it down.

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Steal all 3 key valuables at Kingpin Bowling in Port Gellhorn: the luxury watch (south-east office), the unique Gutterball Moreland 850 shotgun (north-east table), and the office safe (blow it with sticky bombs). It pops after you escape the police. You visit during the Chapter 2 optional mission Hit Kingpin Bowling; if you miss an item, the robbery icon respawns later, so it is not missable.

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: Have maximum strength with both Jason and Lucia at the same time. Available after Coffee Break (Chapter 2). Buy a gym membership and always train with your partner along (call them in): while one trains, the other completes training too. Check strength under Touchpad > Jason & Lucia.

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: Perform 500 actions that affect your criminal profile: stealthy objectives, clean escapes, incapacitations and kills. Turn on criminal profile notifications (Settings > UI > HUD Notifications > Criminal Profile) to see each one count. It fills passively during robberies and fights; if it is last, farm it by running over civilians and cops with a car, but note a Psycho or Irredeemable profile makes cops shoot on sight.

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: Not yet confirmed. PowerPyx lists this trophy as currently unknown, believed to relate to the Payday Loans store from the prologue. No confirmed method has been published yet.

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: Not yet confirmed. PowerPyx lists this trophy as currently unknown, believed to relate to a UFO questline. No confirmed method has been published yet.

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Not yet confirmed. PowerPyx lists this trophy as currently unknown, believed to come from kicking enemies while driving a motorcycle (a melee drive-by). No confirmed method has been published yet.

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Launder $250,000 in marked bills through your contacts (cumulative). First finish Chapter 3, Credit Check (meet Raul's crew), to unlock the Dye Pack Jammer, then rob banks and Payday Loans and sell the marked bills to a fence; Yasmani in Vice City pays the most. Bank vaults pay up to $205,000 in one job.

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops (cumulative). Guns, car mods and tattoos are the priciest, so they get you there fastest.

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Buy all 8 purchasable garages ($160,000 in total) through the Vice City Real Estate phone app, unlocked after the Chapter 2 mission Daily Driver. The 4 story garages do not count.

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app, unlocked after the Chapter 2 mission Moses. Drive stolen cars to Moses in Port Gellhorn, choose Respray then Register (from Chapter 3, standard-tracker cars can also be registered at Pay 'n' Spray). Buy garages first, because each one adds parking spots; register cheap low-end cars to keep costs down.
